title: Internal Medicine consultant md / dnb
description:
**Contact 639865 2832**
**URGENT HIRING**
– CONSULTANT GENERAL MEDICINE
  
  
📍
**Location:**
Tirupur, Tamil Nadu
  
  
🏥
**Hospital Type:**
Multi-Speciality Hospital
  
  
**POSITION**
Consultant General Physician / General Medicine Specialist
  
  
**QUALIFICATION**

* MD General Medicine
* DNB General Medicine
* Valid NMC / Tamil Nadu Medical Council Registration

**Experience**

* Experienced candidates preferred
* Candidates with strong OPD, IPD and emergency medicine experience will be given preference

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct General Medicine OPD consultations and manage IPD patients
* Diagnose and manage acute and chronic medical conditions
* Manage diabetes, hypertension, infections, respiratory disorders and other general medical cases
* Attend to medical emergencies and provide timely stabilization
* Conduct regular inpatient rounds and monitor patient progress
* Review and interpret laboratory investigations, ECG and other diagnostic reports
* Develop appropriate treatment plans and monitor response to treatment
* Manage medical complications in post-operative and critically ill patients
* Provide pre-operative medical evaluation and clearance when required
* Coordinate with Cardiologists, Neurologists, Nephrologists, Gastroenterologists, Surgeons, Intensivists and other specialists
* Counsel patients and attendants regarding diagnosis, treatment, medication, lifestyle modification and follow-up
* Maintain accurate case sheets, prescriptions, progress notes and discharge summaries
* Participate in emergency/on-call duties as per hospital requirements
* Follow hospital, infection-control, patient-safety and clinical protocols

**Required Skills**

* Strong clinical assessment and diagnostic skills
* Good knowledge of acute and emergency medicine
* Ability to independently manage OPD and IPD patients
* Strong clinical decision-making abilities
* Excellent communication and patient counselling skills
* Good multidisciplinary coordination
* Professional, ethical and patient-centric approach

**JOB TYPE**

* Full-Time Consultant
* OPD + IPD + Emergency Responsibilities

**SALARY**
💰 Best in Industry – Negotiable based on qualification and experience
  
  
**Benefits**

* Good patient volume and diverse clinical exposure
* Supportive multidisciplinary clinical team
* Professional learning and development opportunities
* Long-term career growth opportunity

📩 Interested MD/DNB General Medicine candidates may share their updated CV along with total experience, current location, expected salary and notice period.
  
  
**Immediate Joiners Preferred.**

title: Brand Manager
description:
📢
 **WE’RE HIRING: BRAND MANAGER – D2C \& E\-COMMERCE** 




 📍
 **Location:** 
 Tirupur, Tamil Nadu
 



 🏢
 **Brand:** 
 ROBINBOSKY
 



 🏭
 **Industry:** 
 Apparel \| Fashion \| D2C \| E\-commerce
 



 💰
 **Salary:** 
 ₹18,000\- ₹30,000 per month
 



 🧑‍💼
 **Experience:** 
 2–7 Years
 



 ROBINBOSKY is looking for a
 **hands\-on Brand Manager** 
 to take ownership of how our brand is presented, communicated and grown across our website, marketplaces, advertising and social channels.
 



 We sell apparel through our own D2C website and major e\-commerce marketplaces including
 **Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Meesho and others** 
 .
 



 This role is for someone who can bring together:
 



**Product → Brand → Creative → Content → Marketing → E\-commerce → Customer → Growth** 




 This is
 **not just a social\-media posting role** 
 .
 


 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 
**1\. Brand Strategy \& Positioning** 




 • Develop and maintain a clear positioning for ROBINBOSKY
 



 • Ensure consistent brand communication across every customer touchpoint
 



 • Understand our target customers and translate customer insights into better marketing
 



 • Develop messaging for products, collections, campaigns and promotions
 



 • Ensure our products are presented consistently across website, marketplaces and advertising
 



 • Monitor competitors and identify opportunities to differentiate the brand
 



 • Help management develop the long\-term direction of ROBINBOSKY
 



**2\. Creative \& Content Management** 




 • Plan creative requirements for products and marketing campaigns
 



 • Work closely with graphic designers, photographers, video editors and AI creative tools
 



 • Develop briefs for product images, lifestyle images, banners, reels and advertisements
 



 • Review creatives before publishing
 



 • Ensure designs follow brand standards
 



 • Maintain consistency in fonts, visual style, messaging and product presentation
 



 • Plan content around products, occasions, seasons and campaigns
 



 The Brand Manager does not necessarily need to personally design everything.
 



 The responsibility is to make sure the
 **right creative gets produced in the right format for the right purpose** 
 .
 



**3\. D2C Website \& Shopify** 




 • Work closely with the e\-commerce team on ROBINBOSKY's Shopify store
 



 • Review product pages, collections, banners and merchandising
 



 • Improve product presentation and customer experience
 



 • Identify opportunities to improve conversion rates
 



 • Monitor customer behaviour and identify areas where shoppers drop off
 



 • Plan offers, bundles and merchandising strategies
 



 • Coordinate new product and collection launches
 



 • Ensure website communication matches advertising campaigns
 



**4\. Marketplace Brand Management** 




 Coordinate brand presentation across:
 



 • Amazon
 



 • Flipkart
 



 • Myntra
 



 • Meesho
 



 • JioMart
 



 • Other relevant marketplaces
 



 Responsibilities include:
 



 • Product presentation
 



 • Images and listing content
 



 • Brand\-store presentation
 



 • Enhanced / premium content where applicable
 



 • Campaign communication
 



 • Product launches
 



 • Pricing and promotional coordination
 



 • Competitor monitoring
 



**5\. Digital Marketing Coordination** 




 Work with internal teams and external specialists managing:
 



 • Google Ads
 



 • Meta Ads
 



 • Marketplace advertising
 



 • Influencer marketing
 



 • Social media
 



 • Remarketing
 



 • Email / WhatsApp marketing
 



 The Brand Manager should understand advertising performance well enough to determine:
 



**What are we advertising?** 




**Who are we targeting?** 




**What creative are they seeing?** 




**What message are we communicating?** 




**Where are we sending the customer?** 




**And is it actually producing business?** 




 The candidate does not need to personally manage every advertising campaign.
 



 However, they should be able to work effectively with performance\-marketing specialists and make better brand and creative decisions using advertising data.
 



**6\. Product \& Collection Marketing** 




 • Understand ROBINBOSKY's product categories, colours, fits and customer segments
 



 • Develop product positioning and key selling points
 



 • Plan new product launches
 



 • Coordinate product photography and creative requirements
 



 • Develop campaign concepts around individual products or collections
 



 • Analyse which products, colours and styles customers respond to
 



 • Recommend opportunities for new products, bundles and collections
 



**7\. Social Media \& Community** 




 • Develop content direction for Instagram and other relevant platforms
 



 • Plan monthly content calendars
 



 • Coordinate reels, posts, stories and campaigns
 



 • Develop content around products without making every post feel like an advertisement
 



 • Monitor customer comments, feedback and trends
 



 • Identify influencer and creator opportunities
 



 • Maintain consistent brand voice
 



**8\. Customer \& Competitor Research** 




 • Regularly analyse customer reviews and feedback
 



 • Study customer questions, objections and buying behaviour
 



 • Monitor competing apparel brands
 



 • Analyse their products, pricing, promotions, creatives and positioning
 



 • Identify emerging fashion and e\-commerce trends
 



 • Convert research into practical recommendations
 



**9\. AI\-ENABLED BRAND MANAGEMENT** 




 We actively encourage the use of modern AI tools.
 



 Candidates comfortable with tools such as:
 



 • ChatGPT
 



 • Claude
 



 • Gemini
 



 • AI image and video tools
 



 • AI research tools
 



 • Analytics tools
 



 • Automation platforms
 



 will have an advantage.
 



 AI can be used for:
 



 • Consumer research
 



 • Competitor analysis
 



 • Campaign ideation
 



 • Creative briefs
 



 • Copywriting
 



 • Advertisement concepts
 



 • Product positioning
 



 • Data analysis
 



 • Content planning
 



 • Research and reporting
 



 • Workflow automation
 



 We are particularly interested in someone who experiments with
 **new tools and better ways of working** 
 , rather than relying only on traditional methods.
 



**10\. Data \& Performance** 




 The Brand Manager should monitor numbers, not only creatives.
 



 Track areas such as:
 



 • Website traffic
 



 • Conversion rate
 



 • Average order value
 



 • Customer acquisition cost
 



 • Advertising performance
 



 • Product\-level sales
 



 • Marketplace performance
 



 • Creative performance
 



 • Returning customers
 



 • Social engagement
 



 • Customer reviews and feedback
 



 Use this information to continuously improve brand decisions.
 


 INTERNAL COORDINATION
 
 You will work closely with:
 



 • Management
 



 • E\-commerce Operations
 



 • Graphic Designers
 



 • Content / Video Team
 



 • Performance Marketing Team
 



 • Production
 



 • Warehouse \& Dispatch
 



 • Customer Support
 



 • External agencies / freelancers when required
 



 The role requires strong
 **coordination and follow\-up ability** 
 , not only creative thinking.
 


 WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 
 ✅
 **2–7 years of relevant experience** 




 Preferred backgrounds include:
 



 • D2C brands
 



 • Fashion / Apparel
 



 • E\-commerce
 



 • Brand Management
 



 • Digital Marketing
 



 • Consumer brands
 



 • Marketing agencies handling D2C clients
 



 The candidate should have:
 



 • Strong understanding of branding and marketing
 



 • Good visual judgement
 



 • Strong written and verbal communication
 



 • Understanding of digital advertising
 



 • Understanding of e\-commerce
 



 • Good analytical ability
 



 • Experience working with designers and creative teams
 



 • Ability to use data for decision\-making
 



 • Strong coordination and follow\-up skills
 



 • Comfortable working directly with management
 



 • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
 



 • Curiosity about AI and new technology
 



 Experience with
 **Shopify, Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Google Ads or Meta Ads** 
 will be an advantage.
 


 IDEAL PERSON FOR THIS ROLE
 
 We are looking for someone who thinks beyond:
 



**“What should we post on Instagram today?”** 




 and instead asks:
 



**Who is our customer? → What do they want? → Which product should we promote? → What should we communicate? → What creative should we make? → Where should we advertise it? → What happened after launch? → What should we improve next?** 




 The person should have a combination of:
 



 🎨
 **Creative thinking** 




 📊
 **Data\-driven decision making** 




 🛒
 **E\-commerce understanding** 




 📣
 **Marketing knowledge** 




 🤖
 **AI awareness** 




 🎯
 **Strong execution and follow\-up** 



 KEY PERFORMANCE AREAS
 
 Performance will be evaluated based on:
 



 • Brand consistency across channels
 



 • Quality and effectiveness of creatives
 



 • Website and marketplace presentation
 



 • Campaign execution
 



 • Product launch execution
 



 • Improvement in customer engagement
 



 • Advertising creative performance
 



 • E\-commerce growth
 



 • Customer insights generated
 



 • Speed of creative execution
 



 • Successful coordination between teams
 



 • New ideas and experiments implemented
 


 COMPENSATION
 
 💰
 **₹18,000 – ₹30,000 per month** 




 Final compensation will depend on:
 



 • Relevant brand experience
 



 • D2C / e\-commerce exposure
 



 • Apparel / fashion experience
 



 • Creative judgement
 



 • Digital\-marketing knowledge
 



 • Analytical ability
 



 • AI\-tool exposure
 



 • Ability to independently take ownership
 



 📩
 **TO APPLY** 




 Apply through LinkedIn with your updated resume.
 



 Please mention:
 



 • Current Salary
 



 • Expected Salary
 



 • Notice Period
 



 • Current Location
 



 • Brands previously worked with
 



 • E\-commerce / D2C experience
 



 • Digital\-marketing experience
 



 • AI tools you currently use
 



 If available, please also share a
 **portfolio, campaigns, social pages, websites or brands you have previously worked on.**

title: DISPATCH INCHARGE – E-COMMERCE, FBA & STOCK
description:
📢 \*\*WE’RE HIRING: DISPATCH INCHARGE – E\-COMMERCE, FBA \& STOCK
 





 \*\* 📍 \*\*Location:\*\* Tirupur, Tamil Nadu 🏢
 





 \*\*Company:\*\* Robinbosky / ASM Knits
 





 🏭 \*\*Industry:\*\* Apparel Manufacturing \| E\-commerce \| Retail
 





 💰 \*\*
 
**Salary:\*\* ₹18,000 – ₹30,000** 

 per month
 





 🧑‍💼 \*\*Experience:\*\* 2–7 Years
 





 We are looking for an organised and responsible
 
 ﻿
 
 \*\*Dispatch Incharge\*\* to independently handle our \*\*offline orders, bulk shipments, Amazon FBA shipments, marketplace dispatches and stock maintenance\*\*. The candidate should have strong warehouse coordination skills, accuracy in stock handling and the ability to ensure that every shipment leaves \*\*on time, in the correct quantity and with proper documentation\*\*. \#\#\# KEY RESPONSIBILITIES \*\*
 





 1\. Daily Dispatch Management\*\*
 





 • Plan and supervise day\-to\-day dispatch activities
 





 • Ensure orders are picked, checked, packed and dispatched on time
 





 • Handle offline, wholesale, bulk and institutional orders
 





 • Coordinate courier, transport and logistics pickups
 





 • Verify quantity, SKU, size, colour and packing before dispatch
 





 • Ensure correct invoices, labels and shipment documents are attached
 





 • Maintain daily dispatch records and trackers
 





 • Follow up until shipments are handed over successfully
 





 \*\*2\. Amazon FBA \& Bulk Shipments\*\*
 





 • Prepare bulk inventory for Amazon FBA shipments
 





 • Coordinate FBA shipment quantities and SKU\-wise stock
 





 • Ensure correct product labelling, carton labelling and packing
 





 • Verify shipment plans against physically packed quantities
 





 • Prepare cartons according to marketplace requirements
 





 • Maintain carton\-wise and SKU\-wise shipment records
 





 • Coordinate transport / pickup for bulk FBA consignments
 





 • Track shipments until warehouse delivery
 





 • Identify shortages, discrepancies or rejected quantities and follow up for resolution
 





 \*\*3\. Marketplace Shipments\*\*
 





 Coordinate dispatch requirements for marketplaces including:
 





 • Amazon
 





 • Flipkart
 





 • Myntra
 





 • Meesho
 





 • JioMart
 





 • Shopify / D2C orders
 





 • Other e\-commerce channels as required Ensure marketplace orders are processed within required timelines and avoid delays or dispatch errors.
 





 \*\*4\. Offline \& Bulk Orders\*\*
 





 • Handle distributor, retailer, wholesale and other offline shipments
 





 • Prepare order\-wise picking and packing requirements
 





 • Coordinate large\-volume dispatches
 





 • Verify final quantities against invoices / orders
 





 • Coordinate transport arrangements for bulk consignments
 





 • Maintain proof of dispatch and delivery documentation
 





 \*\*5\. Stock Maintenance\*\*
 





 • Maintain accurate physical stock of finished goods
 





 • Ensure inward and outward stock movements are recorded correctly
 





 • Maintain SKU / style / colour / size\-wise stock
 





 • Conduct regular physical stock verification
 





 • Identify stock mismatches and investigate differences
 





 • Monitor damaged, returned, rejected and non\-saleable stock separately
 





 • Coordinate stock transfers between production, warehouse and dispatch
 





 • Ensure stock is stored systematically for easy identification and picking
 





 \*\*6\. Warehouse Organisation\*\*
 





 • Ensure products are stored in clearly identified locations
 





 • Maintain proper racks, bins and SKU identification
 





 • Improve picking and packing efficiency
 





 • Ensure stock is not mixed between styles, sizes or colours
 





 • Maintain cleanliness and organisation in the dispatch and stock areas
 





 • Monitor packing\-material availability
 





 • Inform management in advance when cartons, covers, labels or other materials are running low
 





 \*\*7\. Returns \& Stock Reconciliation\*\*
 





 • Receive returned shipments and verify quantities
 





 • Coordinate checking of returned products
 





 • Segregate saleable, damaged and defective returns
 





 • Ensure returned stock is correctly updated in inventory
 





 • Maintain proper records of marketplace and customer returns
 





 • Report discrepancies to the operations team / management
 





 \*\*8\. Team Handling\*\*
 





 • Allocate work to picking, packing and dispatch staff
 





 • Monitor daily productivity and pending orders
 





 • Ensure staff follow correct packing and stock\-handling processes
 





 • Train new warehouse / dispatch employees
 





 • Maintain discipline and accountability within the dispatch team
 





 • Coordinate closely with production, e\-commerce, accounts and operations teams
 





 \#\#\# REPORTING \& CONTROL The Dispatch Incharge should regularly track:
 





 • Orders pending for dispatch
 





 • Orders dispatched
 





 • FBA shipments pending / completed
 





 • Bulk shipments
 





 • Courier / transporter handovers
 





 • Physical stock
 





 • Stock discrepancies
 





 • Returns received
 





 • Damaged / rejected stock
 





 • Packing\-material availability Any mismatch or delay should be identified and reported quickly rather than discovered later during reconciliation.
 





 \#\#\# CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS
 





 • \*\*2–7 years of experience\*\* in dispatch, warehouse, inventory or logistics operations
 





 • Experience in garments, textiles, e\-commerce or consumer products preferred
 





 • Experience handling \*\*bulk shipments and inventory\*\*
 





 • Amazon FBA / marketplace dispatch experience will be a strong advantage
 





 • Good understanding of SKU\-wise stock maintenance
 





 • Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail
 





 • Basic knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets
 





 • Comfortable working with invoices, shipment labels and dispatch documents
 





 • Ability to manage warehouse / packing staff
 





 • Good coordination and follow\-up skills
 





 • Ability to handle multiple dispatch priorities simultaneously
 





 • Responsible for stock accuracy and timely shipment completion
 





 \#\#\# IDEAL CANDIDATE We are looking for someone who can independently take ownership of:
 





 \*\*Stock → Order → Picking → Checking → Packing → Documentation → Dispatch → Tracking → Reconciliation
 





 \*\* The person should understand that dispatch is not simply moving cartons out of the warehouse. The responsibility is to ensure:
 





 ✅ \*\*Right Product\*\* ✅ \*\*Right SKU \& Quantity\*\* ✅ \*\*Right Packing\*\* ✅ \*\*Right Documentation\*\* ✅ \*\*Right Destination\*\* ✅ \*\*On\-Time Dispatch\*\* ✅ \*\*Accurate Closing Stock\*\*
 





 \#\#\# COMPENSATION 💰 \*\*₹18,000 – ₹30,000 per month
 





 \*\* Final salary will depend on:
 





 • Previous dispatch / warehouse experience
 





 • Stock\-management capability
 





 • Amazon FBA / e\-commerce experience
 





 • Bulk\-shipment handling experience
 





 • Team\-handling ability
 





 • Accuracy and independent working capability
 





 📩 \*\*TO APPLY\*\* Apply through LinkedIn with your updated resume and mention:
 





 • Current Salary
 





 • Expected Salary
 





 • Notice Period
 





 • Current Location
 





 • Total Dispatch / Warehouse Experience
 





 • Amazon FBA / E\-commerce Experience
 





 • Experience handling stock and bulk shipments
